Powerful Features

Everything you need to speed up your computer and free up space, all in one app.

Faster Boot
New

Measure your real startup time with Windows' own records, turn off the apps that slow it down, and follow picture guides for the rest.

Disk Analysis

Visually analyze disk usage. Instantly see which folders take up the most space.

Large File Finder

Instantly detect files over 500 MB. Get rid of forgotten massive files.

Duplicate Detector

Find identical files using SHA-256. Clean up duplicate photos, videos, and documents.

Speed Up

Clean old downloads, system cache, browser cache, and recycle bin with one click. Runs all cleanup tasks automatically.

Downloads Cleaner

Smartly categorize and clean old and unnecessary files in your Downloads folder.

Cache Cleaner

Safely clean system and app cache files. Gain gigabytes of space.

Browser Cache Cleaner

Clean Chrome, Firefox, Edge, and Safari cache with one click.

Recycle Bin

Empty your Recycle Bin to permanently delete files and free up disk space.

DNS Cache Cleaner

Flush your DNS cache to fix connection issues and speed up browsing.

Startup Manager

Manage programs that launch with your computer. Reduce boot time.

System Health Score

Rate your computer's overall health out of 100. See what you can improve.

Empty Folder Finder

Scan your drives for empty folders cluttering your file system. Clean them up in one click.

File Shredder

Securely delete sensitive files with military-grade overwriting (DoD 5220.22-M). Unrecoverable.

Disk Treemap

Visualize your entire disk as an interactive treemap. See exactly what's eating your space.

RAM Optimizer

Free up memory by clearing inactive processes. Boost performance instantly.

Service Manager

Control Windows services that slow down your system. Disable unnecessary background services.

Privacy Report

Get a comprehensive privacy score. See what traces browsers and apps leave behind.

Unused App Detector

List every installed app by size and uninstall the ones you no longer need to free up space.

Visual Duplicate Finder

Find duplicate photos and images in any folder, grouped by file signature.

Disk Health Monitor

See the health status of your SSDs and HDDs and run TRIM on SSDs.

How It Works?

Clean your computer in three simple steps

1
Download & Install

Download the installer, complete setup in minutes. No registration required.

2
Scan

Start disk analysis with one click. Unnecessary files, duplicates, and caches are detected.

3
Clean

Choose what to delete and hit the clean button. Gigabytes of space freed instantly.
